defects.finding: Multiple overlapping current-truth families lack a complete precedence and translation boundary.
Movement publication does not mutate or supersede its target.
Future AI ignores map conclusions, patterns, movement, investigations, and their unified evidence.
Weakening, correction, and supersession semantics are inconsistent and largely unexercised.
Goals, identity, beliefs, patterns, and contradictions have overlapping owners.
Today counts and leads with an old ModelUpdate that has no inspectable movement proof.
A visible conclusion says 50 evidence items while only 45 sources resolve.
Today action labels lose their distinct handlers and destinations; all select one lead.
Map Correct the model confirms an in-memory-only change.
Pattern pointers and aggregate cards are presented as receipts without a first-class receipt object.
Surfaced actions are presented as Decisions and Outcomes without those canonical objects.
When Today has narrative but no hero ID, the provider can silently substitute the first decision as lead.
Non-allowlisted root routes, including Capture, silently render canonical Today fallback.
Independent adapters create surface-specific IDs, labels, counts, and time windows.
Schema comments and local fixture composition conflict with production authority.
Explore navigation discards the selected object's identity and context.

rootCauses: Authority was declared by object family rather than semantic concept and version.
Movement was implemented as a publication ledger before atomic model revision.
Each surface adapts backend families independently.
Presentation aliases filled missing domain objects: pattern aggregates became receipts and surfaced actions became decisions/outcomes.
Visible actions were wired after their destination and command metadata was discarded.
Fixture/reference fallbacks and route quarantine became runtime behavior.
Future AI uses a separate memory authority from the workbench's displayed current model.

salvageability.statement: The permanent shell, Navigator, Inspector structure, adapters, evidence-link tables, durable feedback/check-in writers, safe Inspector capability gating, and report-readiness gates can be retained. The missing work is an integration and authority correction, not a visual rewrite.

reconnect: canonical revision command to evidence, review, current state, and history

salvageability.firstRepair: Implement CONCEPT_KEY_AUTHORITY_REGISTRY and its atomic revision transaction before page-specific presentation changes.

smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.name: establish_concept_key_authority_registry
smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.work: Define one stable semantic concept key, one current revision pointer, explicit version history, and specialised family roles for every governed concept. Remove every path that lets UserMapConclusion, PatternClaim, ContradictionNode, ReferenceItem, or ProfileArtifact independently claim current authority.

smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.name: implement_atomic_revision
smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.work: Lock the current concept revision; validate the reviewer or user decision; preserve the old revision; create the new current revision; attach only resolved user-owned evidence; record before, after, confidence, rationale, and ModelUpdate in the same transaction; reject when ownership, evidence resolution, or transition proof fails.

smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.name: publish_canonical_revision_envelope
smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.work: Today, Map, Timeline, Inspector, Reports, Explore, and future AI must consume the same concept key, canonical revision ID, version, status, confidence, resolved evidence set, rationale, and capabilities. Count only resolvable evidence and inspectable movement.

smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.name: reconnect_capabilities_remove_domain_aliases
smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.work: Preserve Today commands and destinations; route Map correction through atomic revision; carry object context into Explore; allow intended Capture and child routes; and make action reads read-only. Decision and Outcome remain unimplemented first-class objects and must not be aliased from SurfacedAction; present those records truthfully as surfaced actions until the domain objects exist.

smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.name: repair_integrity_and_accept
smallestCorrectIntegrationSequence.work: Quarantine dangling and cross-owner fixtures, rebuild counts from resolved evidence, backfill only provable movement, and run the authenticated acceptance journey.

requiredBrowserAcceptanceJourney: Start with a test account containing one resolvable raw evidence item and no competing fixture records.
Capture or import the evidence and record its immutable source identity.
Generate a proposed interpretation; verify it is visibly proposed and absent from current-model and future-AI projections.
Accept and publish through the atomic revision command.
Verify one old/current/new version chain, one ModelUpdate, exact before/after/confidence/rationale, and only resolved evidence links.
Open Today, Map, Decisions, Timeline, Explore, Navigator, Inspector, and Reports.
Verify the same canonical ID/version, semantic title, evidence count, status, confidence, and movement meaning everywhere.
Verify an explicit consistent time-window policy and that unproved movement is not counted.
Follow Continue, Add what happened, Review outcome, Fieldwork check-in, Capture, Ask in Explore, Correct the model, and Open report; confirm each reaches the named capability with object context.
Refresh after every durable write and re-open through a canonical URL; confirm identical state and evidence.
Generate a new AI response and verify its grounding consumed the accepted canonical version, not the rejected proposal or superseded version.
Weaken or correct the conclusion and verify atomic revision, preserved history, future-AI update, and consistent projections.
Attempt a partial or non-capable Decision; verify full Inspector geometry is disabled and no write is possible.
Attempt unresolved, cross-owner, or missing evidence; verify publication, counting, and reporting fail closed.

validation.qualification: The tests support the documented implementation behavior, including permanent Inspector structure and current route fallback; they do not establish whole-product truth coherence.

finalAnswers.whatExactlyIsCurrentModel: No singular model. Runtime declares a federation of current UserMapConclusion, eligible ContradictionNode, and active ReferenceItem, with overlapping PatternClaim and ProfileArtifact interpretations.
finalAnswers.whereStored: Across the corresponding PostgreSQL tables plus UnderstandingEvidenceLink; ModelUpdate is separate history, not current state.
finalAnswers.whichObjectOwnsEachUnderstanding: No complete ownership map. Goals, values, identity/beliefs, patterns, contradictions, uncertainty, and open questions overlap; Decision and Outcome are not first-class objects.
finalAnswers.howEvidenceChangesIt: Family-specific candidate, link, and publish paths create and annotate records; no one evidence-review atomic old/current/new revision exists.
finalAnswers.modelCanWeakenAndCorrectItself: Partial family fields and controls exist; complete downward or superseding canonical revision was not proved.
